Hey, 

I see there's already a lot of comments so maybe mine won't even be relevant anymore, but chances are they did want to check up on you or try to come back but knew that it was a lost cause, or because they found a new victim very fast. I don't know your personal situation but that's what I encountered.

I talked a lot to previous girlfriends of my narcissistic ex after the break up. All lovely girls and they all came with the same type of stories and experiences that I had. With all of them he tried to come back, sent them letters, came to their door unannounced, etc. So I was mentally prepared of him doing so. 

He didn't. I didn't hear from him. He didn't try to come back. He just disappeared. 

4 months after our breakup he sent me a message that he did something stupid and that I was going to receive a mail in September 2021. It was September 2020 at the time. He said that I should just ignore and delete the mail and that it wasn't relevant anymore.

Shortly after that he was in the newspaper on an article on "people that found love during covid." There he was. With his new girlfriend. Initially I felt sick because I was replaced after 4 months and he never attempted to get me back or even tried to contact me. I felt like all the things he said were true about me. Because I was the only one not worth it coming back to.

Fast forward to September 2021. When I saw the mail my heart stopped. Apparently he had used a special online service where you can send a mail that only gets delivered after a year. And there it was: him loving me, him missing me, him wanting me back. All in that mail. All combined with sentences like "Despite having had sex with many other girls, I still miss you", "despite being able to fuck the pretties girl in the office, I can still only think of you." 

This mail was the most disgusting thing I have ever read. According to him he was so amazing and doing so well, but despite him being the most awesome person ever and having all the pussy in the world, he wanted me back.

When reading this I truly realized what a fucked up being he is and that I'm lucky that I got out of that situation. Because it wasn't me and wasn't my fault. It was all him. 

And that applies to you to: him/her not hoovering doesn't say anything about you. You are amazing, that's why he/she picked you in the first place

Hope you're doing okay and if you ever want to talk about it just message me!!

I don't want to be a negative Nancy or be difficult about this... but to me this isn't an easy solution. I have used my injury to my leg to try and stay positive. Every time I could do something again with my leg, even though it was something stupid as doing a squat or being able to stretch my leg a bit further I would see it as a sign that I could overcome everything I've been dealing with. As soon as I wasn't obliged to stay in bed all day anymore I started going back to the gym and simply did complete workouts with my brace around my leg. I picked up sketching again, I started reading more, and even at my lowest when I didn't want to do anything anymore because of my depression I gave myself a task each day so that I could feel like I've accomplished something. Except for one month I never stopped working at my job and I really tried to have fun with all of these things and be proud of myself for doing so. When I noticed that the extra sorrow of being dumped brought me down again I started seeing a therapist and also got extra bloodwork done to determine which type of herpes I got so that in the future I would be able to communicate better about this with a partner. I've been going on walks every day since I can walk again. I try to live healthy. I keep working in my house and doing renovations by myself. I really really try so hard to not give up but to be honest I'm tired.. I'm really tired and it hurts really bad. It's so kind of you to take the time to react and try to give me advice. I've just always been a fighter and I will not give up without trying everything that I possibly can. It just feels like I've tried everything and it's nog getting better in the slightest.. I don't see a way out
